next.reason: §2023:15.99.3 RV1 keeps the 1985 21-position layout; saying Coordinated Universal Time where 1985 said Greenwich Mean Time, and 'numeric characters' where it said 'digits', changes only the terms. 1985: 'Two numeric digits of the seconds past the minute, in the range 00 through 59' (§1989:A.2.46.3 RV1). 2023: '00 through 59 when a LEAP-SECOND directive with the OFF phrase is in effect' (§2023:15.99.3 RV1), and under OFF 'a value greater than 59 shall not be reported in the seconds position' (§2023:7.3.17.4 GR3). The ON range needs a directive no 1985 program can write. §2023:7.3.17.4 GR1 ('a LEAP-SECOND directive with the OFF phrase is implied') is why a 1985 program is under OFF, but it states the default of a directive 1985 lacks and no 1985 requirement, so it is no longer a target (band-85/slice-10; it was one under adjudicate-712/slice-36).
